candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registar banaka (Register of Banks)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative list of every licensed bank in Montenegro, with per-bank subpages (e.g. /registar-banaka/nlb-banka-ad-podgorica). Seeds the actor list for every other supervision/regulation cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape of the register index plus each institution subpage; diff entity list monthly to detect new/withdrawn licences.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on regulator register terminology
queries_used: CBCG registar banaka i platnih institucija spisak licenci Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registar platnih institucija i njihovih agenata
candidates.why_relevant: Official register of authorised payment institutions plus their agents and branches — the core PSP actor list for the payments sector, including distribution networks that other cells cannot see.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape register page and any attached PDF/XLS; normalise agent lists; snapshot monthly for delta detection.
queries_used: CBCG registar banaka i platnih institucija spisak licenci Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registar institucija za elektronski novac i njihovih agenata / Register of E-money Institutions
candidates.why_relevant: Register of authorised e-money issuers, their branches and agents. English mirror exists, allowing cross-language name normalisation of the same entities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parallel scrape of /me/ and /en/ variants; join on entity identifiers to build a bilingual alias table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: bilingual search (sr + en) of the same register
queries_used: CBCG registar banaka i platnih institucija spisak licenci Crna Gora
Montenegro Central Bank register of licensed payment institutions e-money list

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Spisak platnih institucija i institucija za elektronski novac kojima je oduzeto odobrenje
candidates.why_relevant: Negative register: authorisations withdrawn. This is the only official trail of enforcement/exit events for PSPs and EMIs and is a strong early-warning signal on supervisory action.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape + diff; treat each new row as an enforcement event with date of withdrawal.
queries_used: CBCG registar banaka i platnih institucija spisak licenci Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registar platnih sistema
candidates.why_relevant: Lists designated payment systems operating in Montenegro under the Law on Payment Transactions — infrastructure-level actor map (RTGS/DNS operators, card schemes if designated).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency scrape (quarterly); changes are rare but high-signal.
queries_used: CBCG registar banaka i platnih institucija spisak licenci Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registri (payment-system register hub page)
candidates.why_relevant: Single hub linking all CBCG payment-side registers; the cheapest crawl seed and the place where new register types appear first when the law changes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as crawl entry point; monitor for newly added child links (signals new licensing regime).
queries_used: CBCG registar banaka i platnih institucija spisak licenci Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Mikrokreditne finansijske institucije (register of MFIs)
candidates.why_relevant: Covers the non-bank credit tier (MFIs, and the broader 'pružaoci finansijskih usluga' branch: leasing, factoring, credit-guarantee) — actors frequently missed when only banks/PSPs are tracked.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the parent 'pruzaoci-finansijskih-usluga' path to enumerate all non-bank provider registers, then scrape each.
queries_used: CBCG registar banaka i platnih institucija spisak licenci Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Centralni registar transakcionih računa pravnih lica i preduzetnika (CRTR)
candidates.why_relevant: Central register of transaction accounts of legal entities/entrepreneurs; indirectly reveals which banks hold which corporate account relationships and publishes account-population statistics.
candidates.access_status: open_web (search UI; bulk access likely restricted)
candidates.legal_status: public_official_information; personal-data limits on natural persons
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Collect the published aggregate figures and any downloadable files; avoid mass-querying the lookup UI for individual entities.
queries_used: CBCG registar blokiranih računa mjenica prinudna naplata spisak

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Prinudna naplata: podaci o blokiranim pravnim licima i preduzetnicima
candidates.why_relevant: Enforcement register published as downloadable PDF and Excel with periodic cut-off dates — machine-readable, longitudinal credit-distress dataset, plus a searchable debtor lookup.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the periodic XLS/PDF snapshots by cut-off date and build a time series; also capture 'Pokazatelji prinudne naplate' aggregates.
queries_used: CBCG registar blokiranih računa mjenica prinudna naplata spisak

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Kreditni registar (Credit Registry) service pages
candidates.why_relevant: Defines which institutions are obliged reporters to the credit registry — an indirect but authoritative enumeration of regulated lenders, and a pointer to reporting rulebooks/deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape page and linked rulebooks; extract obliged-entity definitions and reporting deadlines.
queries_used: Montenegro Central Bank register of licensed payment institutions e-money list

candidates.source_name: Centralni registar privrednih subjekata (CRPS) — pretraga registra
candidates.why_relevant: National company register run under the Tax Administration. Resolves legal names, registration numbers, ownership and status for every bank, PSP, agent and fintech, and is the join key between CBCG registers and corporate data.
candidates.access_status: open search portal; some documents paid/certified
candidates.legal_status: public register; terms of use apply to bulk extraction
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted lookups for the entity list produced by the CBCG registers rather than bulk crawling; check for an official data-export or API route first.
queries_used: Centralni registar privrednih subjekata Crna Gora CRPS pretraga Poreska uprava

candidates.source_name: eFirma / IRMS portal (Poreska uprava) — business-entity register search
candidates.why_relevant: Newer Tax Administration front end to the same registry data; more likely than legacy crps.me to expose structured/JSON endpoints and to remain live as the legacy site is retired.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect network calls for a JSON search endpoint; if present, query per-entity at polite rate.
queries_used: Centralni registar privrednih subjekata Crna Gora CRPS pretraga Poreska uprava

candidates.source_name: Registar stvarnih vlasnika (Beneficial Ownership Register), CRPS/eFirma
candidates.why_relevant: UBO register established 1 Aug 2021 under the AML/CFT law; the only official route to ultimate ownership of licensed financial institutions, agents and exchange offices, and a direct AML-supervision touchpoint.
candidates.access_status: search available; certified extracts may require digital certificate / fee
candidates.legal_status: statutory register; personal-data restrictions apply to UBO details
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/targeted lookups for regulated entities only; do not bulk-harvest personal data; retain minimal fields.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on AML register terminology
queries_used: Registar stvarnih vlasnika Crna Gora CRPS beneficial ownership pretraga

candidates.source_name: Službeni list Crne Gore — official gazette archive and search
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative publication of every law, decree and CBCG decision, with a searchable archive back to 1945 and a separate register of consolidated texts ('prečišćeni tekstovi'). It is the definitive date-of-entry-into-force and deadline source, and it preserves texts after ministry pages are taken down.
candidates.access_status: public site; full text of some issues behind subscription
candidates.legal_status: official publication; reuse of official texts generally permitted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the content search by 'oblast=propisi' and podoblast parameters (URL-parameterised, scrapable); harvest issue metadata and consolidated-text register entries.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on gazette archive terminology
queries_used: Službeni list Crne Gore arhiva pretraga propisa sluzbenilist.me

candidates.source_name: PROPISI.NET Montenegro (me.propisi.net) — commercial consolidated-law archive
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator mirroring every Službeni list CG issue (including municipal gazettes) with daily update logs ('Dnevna ažurnost'). Useful as a redundancy layer and for change-detection when the official site lags or removes content.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the free 'Dnevna ažurnost' change feed for signals only; do not scrape paywalled texts — resolve to the official gazette instead.
queries_used: Službeni list Crne Gore arhiva pretraga propisa sluzbenilist.me
candidates.observed_blocker: subscription-based access indicated on listing pages

candidates.source_name: Katalog Propisa (katalogpropisa.me) — updated-regulations overview
candidates.why_relevant: Second commercial catalogue of Montenegrin regulations with an explicit 'updated regulations' view — a cheap change-detection signal for amendments to banking/payments laws.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the free update-overview page for changed-regulation titles/dates; verify against Službeni list.
queries_used: Službeni list Crne Gore arhiva pretraga propisa sluzbenilist.me

candidates.source_name: Skupština Crne Gore — Pretraga zakona i drugih akata (bill tracker / archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Parliamentary act database with status filters (in procedure, adopted, withdrawn — status parameter is URL-addressable) and attached committee reports and PDF texts. It is the pre-gazette pipeline: it shows deadlines and drafts before they become law and preserves withdrawn drafts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the act search with status parameters (e.g. ?status=Povučen+iz+procedure) and harvest attached PDFs from /zakoni/web/dokumenta/; filter by financial-sector keywords.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on parliamentary archive terms
queries_used: Skupština Crne Gore zakoni arhiva predlozi zakona pretraga skupstina.me

candidates.source_name: eUprava — e-participacija / javne rasprave (public consultation archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Central archive of public consultations on draft laws and strategies, each with a stated consultation window (typically 30 days). It is the canonical index of consultation deadlines and often keeps the draft after the ministry page is removed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the consultation listing daily; extract title, initiating ministry, start/end date and attachments; cross-check the older eusluge.euprava.me/eParticipacija/Rasprave/ path which may still hold legacy entries.
queries_used: eUprava Crna Gora portal e-konsultacije javna rasprava nacrt zakona arhiva gov.me

candidates.source_name: gov.me — Government/ministry news and consultation notices
candidates.why_relevant: Ministries (notably Ministarstvo finansija) publish consultation calls and deadlines as /clanak/ pages; these are the first public announcement and the URL pattern is stable and crawlable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to ministry news listings / RSS if present; keyword-filter for 'javna rasprava', 'konsultacije', 'nacrt'; archive each notice page immediately (they are frequently reorganised).
queries_used: eUprava Crna Gora portal e-konsultacije javna rasprava nacrt zakona arhiva gov.me

candidates.source_name: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore (Capital Market Authority) — registers/licences
candidates.why_relevant: Second financial-sector regulator; maintains a register of licences for investment services provided by investment firms AND by authorised credit institutions — i.e. it holds licence data about banks that CBCG registers do not show.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /regulativa and register sections; extract licence-holder lists and the rulebook governing the licence register.
queries_used: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore registar licenciranih društava; Agencija za nadzor osiguranja registar

candidates.source_name: Agencija za nadzor osiguranja Crne Gore (Insurance Supervision Agency) — registers
candidates.why_relevant: Registers of insurers, branches of foreign insurers, brokers, agents and agencies — the bancassurance-adjacent actor list, and the third supervisory authority whose consultations and deadlines run in parallel to CBCG's.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the 'registri' section and scrape entity lists; note the confusable Bosnian agencies ano.ba / azobih.gov.ba when disambiguating.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search; disambiguated from BiH namesakes
queries_used: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore registar licenciranih društava; Agencija za nadzor osiguranja registar

candidates.source_name: Registar zaloga Crne Gore (Pledge Register) via sudovi.me
candidates.why_relevant: Public register of pledges over movable assets — reveals which lenders are taking security over what, i.e. an indirect map of secured-lending activity by bank and MFI, plus a judicial-branch data source distinct from CBCG.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted creditor-name searches for the licensed-institution list; capture counts and dates rather than debtor personal data.
queries_used: sudovi.me sudski registar pretraga predmeta Crna Gora; Komora javnih izvršitelja imenik

candidates.source_name: Komora javnih izvršitelja Crne Gore — imenik izvršitelja i propisi
candidates.why_relevant: Official directory of public bailiffs (the enforcement channel banks use for retail/SME debt) plus a curated 'propisi' and 'načelni pravni stavovi' section that archives enforcement-law texts and binding legal positions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the imenik (name, seat, territorial jurisdiction) and monitor /propisi/zakoni and /propisi/nacelnistavovi for enforcement-law changes.
queries_used: sudovi.me sudski registar pretraga predmeta Crna Gora; Komora javnih izvršitelja imenik

candidates.source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — snapshots of cbcg.me, gov.me, euprava.gov.me, skupstina.me
candidates.why_relevant: The archival backstop for this cell: Montenegrin regulator and ministry sites are frequently reorganised (cbcg.me already shows mangled legacy paths in search indexes, and gov.me migrated from older portals). Wayback preserves consultation drafts, deadline notices and superseded register versions after removal, and supports point-in-time diffing of register membership.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the CDX API (http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=cbcg.me/*&output=json) to enumerate snapshots per register URL; also submit live register URLs to Save Page Now on each collection run so a controlled snapshot exists.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (who archives) — required by the cell's archival-pointer mandate

candidates.source_name: NATLEX (ILO) — Montenegro legislation records with archived Službeni list PDFs
candidates.why_relevant: International body that mirrors Montenegrin Official Gazette texts as durable PDFs — a fallback copy when sluzbenilist.me paywalls or reorganises an issue.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query NATLEX by country=Montenegro for financial/commercial subject codes; fetch PDFs as archival copies.
queries_used: Službeni list Crne Gore arhiva pretraga propisa sluzbenilist.me

candidates.source_name: registarfirmi.me — commercial company-profile aggregator (Montenegro)
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party mirror of CRPS company data with clean per-entity URLs; useful for fast name resolution and alias discovery when the official portals are down or rate-limited. Not authoritative — always reconcile against CRPS.
candidates.legal_status: commercial reuse of public register data; ToS unverified
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use only as a name/alias lookup aid at low volume; never as the system of record.
queries_used: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore registar licenciranih društava; Agencija za nadzor osiguranja registar

negative_findings.description: No open-data API, bulk download or data.gov.me-style dataset was located for the CBCG registers of banks, payment institutions or e-money institutions; all appear to be HTML pages (with some PDF/XLS attachments on the enforcement pages).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sr and en returned only human-facing register pages; no API documentation surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must rely on HTML scraping with change-detection, which is brittle against the site reorganisations already visible in cbcg.me URL patterns; budget for snapshotting.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of a permanent, searchable archive of CLOSED public consultations with their original attachments — the eUprava e-participacija section surfaces active/recent 'javne rasprave', and a legacy path (eusluge.euprava.me/eParticipacija/Rasprave/) exists but its retention depth was not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language search 'javna rasprava arhiva nacrt zakona' returned individual consultation pages and ministry news items, not a closed-consultation archive index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consultation drafts and deadline notices are exactly the content that disappears; without an official archive, Wayback/Save-Page-Now capture on first sighting becomes mandatory rather than optional.

negative_findings.description: No public CBCG register of currency-exchange offices (mjenjačnice) or of payment-service agents operating on a cross-border/passporting basis was located in this pass, and no register of 'mjenice' (promissory notes) was confirmed despite the local term being searched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search on 'mjenica'/'blokirani računi' returned only the forced-collection (prinudna naplata) pages, not a separate bill-of-exchange register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If such registers exist off the main navigation, a whole class of regulated actors is missing from the seed list; if they do not exist, that absence itself is a structural finding about ME supervision transparency.

negative_findings.description: Local-language queries for 'Agencija za nadzor osiguranja' and 'Komisija za vrijednosne papire' return predominantly Bosnian/Federation-of-BiH institutions (ano.ba, azobih.gov.ba, komvp.gov.ba) rather than Montenegrin ones.
negative_findings.result_summary: Montenegrin entities resolved only as ano.me and scmn.me after manual disambiguation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Noisy terms: any automated query expansion in sr must be domain-pinned to .me (and to Podgorica) or the corpus will be contaminated with BiH and RS regulators.

negative_findings.description: The company register is reachable through at least four distinct hosts (crps.me, pretraga.crps.me, efirma.tax.gov.me, irms.tax.gov.me), several still on plain HTTP, suggesting an in-progress migration to the Tax Administration IRMS platform.
negative_findings.result_summary: All four hosts appeared in search results for the same registry function.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any hard-coded CRPS URL is likely to break; the collector should resolve the register through a small host-priority list and record which host answered.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice are recorded from search-engine results and inferred site structure; none were fetched and none should be treated as liveness-verified. Some cbcg.me URLs seen in indexes contain corrupted path fragments (e.g. /cuymrbfb.html/, /sliNe_i_fajlovi/), which are hypotheses about legacy or mangled paths rather than confirmed routes.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness deliberately left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The verifier should canonicalise cbcg.me paths and, on 404, retry the equivalent /me/ and /en/ prefixes before marking anything dead.

coverage_gaps.description: No court/insolvency register was identified: no searchable bankruptcy (stečaj) or liquidation register for Montenegrin companies, and no public case-law/decision database for the commercial court (Privredni sud) was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted follow-up on sudovi.me subsites and the Privredni sud Crne Gore pages using terms 'stečajni postupak', 'likvidacija', 'sudska praksa', plus the e-Justice EU portal's Montenegro country page.

coverage_gaps.description: No proactive archiving of Montenegrin regulator pages is in place; Wayback coverage depth for cbcg.me register pages and euprava.gov.me consultation pages is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a CDX-API census of snapshot density per priority URL, then wire Save Page Now into every collection run so removed pages remain recoverable.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage is strong in Montenegrin/Serbian Latin script but nothing was tested in Cyrillic script variants (e.g. 'Регистар банака', 'Службени лист Црне Горе'), and no check was made for whether official sites serve Cyrillic mirrors.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run the core register and gazette queries in Cyrillic transliteration to confirm whether any content is script-gated; record the result either way.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign/EU institutions operating into Montenegro (representative offices of foreign banks, cross-border card acquirers, crypto-asset service providers under any new ME regime) have no identified register.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search CBCG for 'predstavništva stranih banaka' and for any 'virtuelna imovina / kripto' licensing pages; check whether a VASP register was created by recent AML amendments.

coverage_gaps.description: Whether the beneficial-ownership register and CRPS permit systematic (as opposed to case-by-case) lookups is unresolved; both may impose digital-certificate authentication or fees for full extracts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read the CRPS/eFirma terms-of-use and fee schedule pages before any automated querying, and document the permitted-use conclusion in the source record.

brief: Montenegro's register landscape for banking and payments is unusually well centralised but almost entirely HTML-only: the CBCG hosts an authoritative set of registers (banks, payment institutions and agents, e-money institutions and agents, payment systems, microcredit institutions, plus a negative list of withdrawn authorisations and a machine-readable forced-collection/blocked-accounts dataset), which together seed the actor list for every other cell. Corporate identity and ownership resolve through the CRPS company register and the beneficial-ownership register, now migrating across four hosts under the Tax Administration (crps.me, pretraga.crps.me, efirma.tax.gov.me, irms.tax.gov.me), while legal and deadline authority sits with Službeni list Crne Gore's searchable archive back to 1945, backstopped by the parliamentary act database at zakoni.skupstina.me and mirrored commercially by me.propisi.net and katalogpropisa.me. The weakest link is preservation: consultation drafts and deadline notices live on eUprava e-participacija and gov.me article pages with no identified permanent archive of closed consultations, so Wayback CDX enumeration plus Save-Page-Now capture on first sighting should be treated as a mandatory part of collection rather than a fallback. Two structural cautions for automation: sr-language queries for insurance and securities regulators are heavily contaminated by Bosnian namesakes and must be domain-pinned to .me, and no URL in this slice has been fetched, so all liveness is left to the deterministic verification pass.
